critical_bugs.quote: The biggest struggle that I have on the accounts page is that it defaults to searching by owner.
critical_bugs.summary: Account search defaults to 'owner' filter, causing reps who need cross-territory visibility (e.g., covering for colleagues) to miss results and think accounts don't exist.

data_problems.quote: today I got credit for a new order, but it was not new, meaning that they order every 6 months. So, it was new on the definition of comp, but they are reoccurring customer. If it's new, I need to see a difference between that and someone that's just new visav the designation of the incentive plan.
data_problems.summary: System does not distinguish between a truly new customer and a recurring customer whose reorder is flagged as "new" for comp purposes, causing confusion.

data_problems.quote: those tasks sit inside 100% of the time an opportunity. There is no random task that's right.
data_problems.summary: Tasks should always be nested under an opportunity; standalone tasks don't reflect how reps actually work.

data_problems.quote: there's nowhere in the entire company even contracts that I can go for a source of truth list of that period at all... it's stuff that can fall through the cracks and I have to ask once in a while
data_problems.summary: No centralized source of truth exists for direct contract data; rep must manually chase contracting team periodically.

data_problems.quote: you could put here is your monthto date and how much each person or each client has used visav rolling quarter or rolling month or what they should be ordering... quarters are irrelevant to us anymore... we are monthtomonth
data_problems.summary: Rolling quarter view is irrelevant for this business; data should be structured around monthly cycles and individual customer reorder cadence instead.

data_problems.quote: I would love to see because who's Marissa? No clue, So what I would say is what's the account, what's the actual name of the hospital? GO and wholesaler are all I mean we can never ever see enough of that.
data_problems.summary: Meeting/task cards lack sufficient contextual detail (account name, GPO, wholesaler) making it hard to recall who a contact is.

data_problems.quote: there's tons of stuff that's open the company because we weren't going to sell that drug anymore closed all the ops so we can't even see them. they went away and then a year and a half later they decided we are going to sell that product again. So we lost all of that.
data_problems.summary: Bulk-closing opportunities for discontinued products causes permanent loss of historical data when products are relaunched later.
